question: Pointing towards Savitri, Kartik said, "She is the sister of my brother's mother's son." How is Savitri related to Kartik?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1547ed4a509f0a6bfe8df80f658e3f39359c9e9889086a7427a6110c94ecf76.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0bf23581ccab3a221a8d40bea79f14ac82f6ca711e364800f6b1af5c3da61c8.png] 

 
• My brother's mother's son → Kartik's Mother 's son is brother of Kartik.
 
• Savitri is the sister of my brother's mother's son → Savitri is the sister of brother of Kartik, which implies Savitri is the sister of Kartik.

Clearly, Savitri is sister of Kartik.

Hence, '**Sister**' is the correct answer.
